payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each starting index i, find the leftmost occurrence of 'bear' at or after i, then count all ending indices j beyond the 'bear' end; this greedily ensures all substrings containing at least one 'bear' are counted.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy strategy where for each i it takes the earliest bear, effectively a two-pointer approach with i and the bear start index advancing monotonically.
